scenarios.name: Navigate to the ends of a staged target list

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
ribbon customization is open in the MCAD Software for the Part Tools target
"2-D Drawing", "2D Sketches" and "3D Annotations" are staged in that order
all three staged rows have Large and Text unchecked
the user selects "3D Annotations" in the target list and presses Home
the three rows remain in their original order with their display options unchecked
the customization dialog closes without applying the staged commands
